arguments.thoughts: Scroll further to reveal the full English ingredients text under the Ingredients section, which is not yet visible in the DOM snapshot.

criterion_order: Open the exact Open Food Facts product record for barcode 3017620422003
Report NOVA card processing classification and marker count (visible wording)
Report energy per 100 g with displayed units
Report complete displayed English ingredients text
criterion_descriptions: Agent navigates to the Open Food Facts page for barcode 3017620422003 (and does not intentionally substitute a different Nutella barcode/package size). Full credit if the agent clearly targets this exact barcode record. Full credit also if Open Food Facts is inaccessible (e.g., down/CAPTCHA/blocked) but the agent clearly reports the access issue and shows it attempted to reach the specified barcode page. Partial credit if the agent references the correct product but the barcode targeting is unclear. No credit if the agent uses a different barcode/variant when the requested record is accessible.

Agent reports the product name as displayed on the record and the barcode number (3017620422003). Full credit if both are correctly captured from the page. If the page/record cannot be accessed or the name is not displayed, full credit if the agent clearly states that the value is unavailable due to access/display limitations while confirming it attempted the specified barcode page. Partial credit if only one of the two is provided or if minor transcription error occurs in the name while barcode is correct. No credit if barcode is wrong or corresponds to a different product record.

Agent reports the Nutri-Score exactly as displayed on the product page (e.g., letter grade and any visible labeling). Full credit for exact visible value. Full credit also if Nutri-Score is not shown and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed/unavailable on the page. Partial credit if Nutri-Score is given but is ambiguous or not clearly indicated as the displayed value.

Agent reports the processing classification exactly as shown in the NOVA card and includes the marker count wording/number shown (e.g., 'NOVA X' and 'Y markers'). Must be based on the visible NOVA card, not inferred from ingredients. Full credit if both classification and marker count match the page. Full credit also if the NOVA card/marker count is missing/unavailable and the agent explicitly reports it is not shown. Partial credit if only one of the two is reported.

Agent reports the energy value from the per-100-g nutrition column and preserves the displayed energy units exactly as shown (e.g., kJ and/or kcal formatting). Full credit if value and units match exactly and are explicitly per 100 g. Full credit also if the nutrition table/per-100-g column or energy row is not displayed and the agent explicitly states it is unavailable on the page. Partial credit if the correct number is given but units are missing or per-100-g context is unclear. No credit if a per-serving value is used when per-100-g is available.

Agent reports the sugars value from the per-100-g nutrition column exactly as displayed (including decimal formatting and unit if shown). Full credit for exact transcription. Full credit also if the sugars value or the per-100-g column is not displayed and the agent explicitly states it is unavailable on the page. Partial credit if sugars are correct but per-100-g context is unclear or unit is omitted. No credit if per-serving sugars are reported instead of per 100 g when per-100-g exists.

Agent provides the full English ingredients text exactly as displayed on the Open Food Facts page (complete, not summarized, not edited). Full credit if the entire displayed English ingredients string is reproduced without omissions. Full credit also if English ingredients are not displayed/available (e.g., only another language is shown or the section is missing) and the agent explicitly states that the English ingredients text is not available on the page. Partial credit if mostly complete but missing minor parts that are clearly part of the displayed English text. No credit if ingredients are paraphrased, translated, or inferred rather than copied from the displayed English text.

Agent uses only the specified barcode record (no substitution), does not edit/upload anything to Open Food Facts, and stops after recording all requested fields (or explicitly noting which requested fields are not displayed/unavailable). Full credit if constraints are followed and the response contains only the requested information (allowing brief statements of unavailability where applicable). Partial credit if minor extra context is included but constraints are still followed. No credit if the agent substitutes another product/barcode or performs edits/uploads.
